The joint subgroup failure is a notable caveat — joint-predominant SLE may be less IFN-driven. 5. CONFOUNDERS: No major confounders identified. The trial was adequately powered (n=373), had a placebo comparator, and ran for 52 weeks — appropriate for SLE. Safety profile showed modestly higher AESIs in the anifrolumab arm (16.1% vs 11.0%) including infections and herpes zoster, consistent with immunosuppression, but no dose-limiting toxicity pattern that would have compromised dosing. The trial is a clear success.
